answer: Duplicating identities means re-staking real jade per sybil plus burning compute on every challenge, so costs scale linearly while influence stays capped per stake. Each agent must stake a jade token as a bonded anchor before voting, and a random lantern challenge requires proving unique hardware work within one epoch. Attackers gain little: fake identities dilute rewards but never exceed the bonded weight of legitimate jade holders, making mass sybil farms economically irrational. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
